answer_1.quote: The automation of chart comprehension and summarization has garnered significant attention from the research community.

answer_2.quote: The low-level score is calculated based on a comparison between the ground truth and the generated code, focusing on the code similarities in four aspects: text, layout, type, and color.

answer_3.quote: The high-level score utilizes GPT-4o to evaluate the detailed similarity between the ground truth and generated chart images in six aspects: chart types, layout, text content, data, style, and clarity.

answer_4.quote: To ensure data quality, we randomly sample around 1k instances and evaluate the quality of the chart images manually during the dataset construction period.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate the quality of the chart images
